import json, threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

SEEN = []

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a):  # keep it quiet
        pass
    def do_POST(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get(\"Content-Length\", 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))
        SEEN.append((self.path, dict(self.headers), body))
        if body[\"model\"] == \"boom\":
            payload = json.dumps({\"error\": {\"message\": \"model not found\", \"type\": \"invalid_request_error\"}}).encode()
            self.send_response(404)
            self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")
            self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(payload)))
            self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(payload); return
        if body.get(\"stream\"):
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"text/event-stream\")
            self.end_headers()
            events = [
                (\"response.created\", {\"type\": \"response.created\", \"response\": {\"id\": \"resp_1\"}}),
                (\"response.output_text.delta\", {\"type\": \"response.output_text.delta\", \"delta\": \"Secret\"}),
                (\"response.output_text.delta\", {\"type\": \"response.output_text.delta\", \"delta\": \" sauce\"}),
                (\"response.completed\", {\"type\": \"response.completed\", \"response\": {\"id\": \"resp_1\"}}),
            ]
            for name, data in events:
                self.wfile.write(f\"event: {name}\\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\\n\\n\".encode())
            self.wfile.flush(); return
        payload = json.dumps({
            \"id\": \"resp_42\", \"model\": body[\"model\"], \"output_text\": None,
            \"usage\": {\"input_tokens\": 3, \"output_tokens\": 5},
            \"output\": [
                {\"type\": \"reasoning\", \"summary\": []},
                {\"type\": \"message\", \"id\": \"msg_1\", \"role\": \"assistant\",
                 \"content\": [{\"type\": \"output_text\", \"text\": \"The answer is 42.\", \"annotations\": []}]},
            ],
        }).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")
        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(payload)

def serve():
    srv = HTTPServer((\"127.0.0.1\", 8799), H)
    t = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    return srv
